# Computes the square root of the Manhattan distance An example of a Euclidean embeddable distance metric

Computes the square root of the Manhattan distance An example of a
Euclidean embeddable distance metric

## Usage

``` r
sqrtManhattan(X)
```

## Arguments

- X:

  matrix of samples x variables for computation of samples x samples
  distance matrix

## Value

a dist object

## Examples

``` r
sqrtManhattan(iris[,1:4])
```
